build.scope: One compiler subprocess; CPU difference includes its waited descendants. RSS is the host cumulative-child high-water value, not candidate SRAM.

candidate_heap_call_scan: no forbidden allocation calls in the bound candidate source set

query_instrumentation.meaning: Only the definition symbol is renamed; unchanged internal re_query calls bind the host recorder, which forwards unchanged arguments. The numerical body and canonical source are unchanged. This avoids assumptions about same-translation-unit linker wrapping.

resources_before_final_receipt.scope: Python process including in-process qualification C kernels, measured from main entry before final receipt serialization. Compiler child resources are separate. No Cortex-M23 timing claim.

stack.scope: No-inline/no-sibling-call host frames summed conservatively along project source paths. Qualification wrappers and Python reference memory are outside candidate storage. Libm/libc, hardware ISR/runtime and caller frames remain in the separate unmeasured reserve; no target measurement.
